title: Add optional page subtitle/introduction field
description: Address item 1 of `novas-tasks.md` (`referencia.png`): below the page title, allow the user to type an optional subtitle/introduction (Zeroheight shows a muted 'Add an introduction (optional)' placeholder directly under the title). `SectionHeader.tsx` already accepts a `description?: string` prop rendered via `adminTypography.description`, but no field exists on the data model and `PageContentPage.tsx` never passes it (per its own doc comment: 'Não há campo de descrição por página hoje'). Add a nullable `subtitulo` column to `pages` (drizzle schema + generated migration), expose it in the page tRPC procedures, and wire an inline-editable input in `PageContentPage.tsx` that saves it (debounced, same pattern as other inline-editable fields) and feeds `SectionHeader`'s existing `description` prop.
acceptanceCriteria: `pages` table has a nullable `subtitulo` column (drizzle migration generated via `db:generate`, never hand-edited)
tRPC page read/update procedures include `subtitulo` in their input/output shapes
`PageContentPage.tsx` renders an inline-editable subtitle field directly under the title, showing a muted 'Add an introduction (optional)' placeholder when empty, matching `referencia.png`
Typing in the subtitle field persists via the existing debounce/autosave pattern used elsewhere in the editor
`SectionHeader.tsx`'s existing `description` prop plumbing is reused, not duplicated

steps.details: Add nullable `subtitulo` text column to `pages` in `apps/server/src/db/schema.ts`; run `pnpm --filter @systembook/server db:generate`.
Include `subtitulo` in the relevant page router input/output (read + update mutation) and shared types in `packages/schema` if applicable.
In `PageContentPage.tsx`, add the subtitle input below the title, pass its value into `SectionHeader`'s `description` prop, and wire debounced save on change.
Confirm placeholder, typing, persistence after reload, and that pages without a subtitle render the muted placeholder like `referencia.png`.

technicalNotes: `SectionHeader.tsx` already has the `description` prop and typography wired — this task only needs to supply real data, not build new presentation.
